subject.title: fix(agy): pass print prompt as flag argument

question: Should summarize reverse its intentional stdin-only Antigravity prompt design and support current `agy` by placing extracted content in process argv?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but merged history proves stdin transport was a deliberate confidentiality boundary, so compatibility versus process-argument exposure requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Accept bounded argv compatibility
options.body: Merge and explicitly treat Antigravity as unsuitable for large or sensitive extracted content despite application-level redaction.

options.title: Pause Antigravity support
options.body: Preserve the confidentiality boundary and wait for a supported stdin or file prompt interface.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded argv compatibility
recommendation.body: Merge and explicitly treat Antigravity as unsuitable for large or sensitive extracted content despite application-level redaction.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the prior stdin-safety commits that this PR reverses and maintains the shared execution boundary.
